db:select.doc:name: Fetch Customer Profile
db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id, home_country, risk_level, average_transaction_amount FROM customer_profile WHERE customer_id = :customerId

db:select.doc:name: Fetch 10 Minute Velocity
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE customer_id = :customerId AND occurred_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AND transaction_id <> :transactionId

db:select.doc:name: Fetch 24 Hour Velocity
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE customer_id = :customerId AND occurred_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND transaction_id <> :transactionId

db:select.doc:name: Check Merchant History
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS merchant_count FROM transactions WHERE customer_id = :customerId AND merchant_id = :merchantId AND merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND transaction_id <> :transactionId

db:select.doc:name: Check Device History
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM transactions WHERE customer_id = :customerId AND device_id = :deviceId AND device_id IS NOT NULL AND transaction_id <> :transactionId

#[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-004', description: 'Customer exceeded configured 24 hour transaction amount limit', severity: 'HIGH'}]]
#[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-005', description: 'Transaction uses a merchant not previously seen for this customer', severity: 'MEDIUM'}]]

when.expression: #[ !isEmpty(vars.customerProfile.home_country default '') and !isEmpty(vars.transaction.merchantCountry default '') and upper(vars.transaction.merchantCountry) != upper(vars.customerProfile.home_country) ]

set-variable.value: #[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-006', description: 'Merchant country differs from customer home country', severity: 'MEDIUM'}]]
#[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-007', description: 'Transaction uses a device not previously seen for this customer', severity: 'MEDIUM'}]]

when.expression: #[ !isEmpty(vars.customerProfile.home_country default '') and !isEmpty(vars.transaction.ipCountryCode default '') and upper(vars.transaction.ipCountryCode) != upper(vars.customerProfile.home_country) ]

set-variable.value: #[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-008', description: 'IP country differs from customer home country', severity: 'MEDIUM'}]]
#[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-009', description: 'Transaction received outside configured usual hours of 08:00 to 22:00', severity: 'LOW'}]]
#[vars.ruleHits ++ [{code: 'FR-010', description: 'Transaction belongs to a configured high-risk merchant category', severity: 'HIGH'}]]
#[ if (vars.insufficientData) 'REVIEW' else if (vars.finalScore >= 70) 'DECLINE' else if (vars.finalScore >= 30) 'REVIEW' else 'APPROVE' ]
set-variable.doc:name: Determine Fraud Verdict

set-variable.value: #[ if (vars.insufficientData) 'INSUFFICIENT_CUSTOMER_DATA' else if (vars.verdict == 'DECLINE') 'HIGH_FRAUD_RISK' else if (vars.verdict == 'REVIEW') 'SUSPICIOUS_TRANSACTION' else if (!isEmpty(vars.ruleHits)) 'LOW_RISK_RULE_MATCH' else 'NORMAL_TRANSACTION' ]
set-variable.doc:name: Determine Reason Code

logger.doc:name: Log Fraud Result
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- 'Fraud analysis completed. Transaction=' ++ (vars.transaction.transactionId as String) ++ ', Score=' ++ (vars.finalScore as String) ++ ', Verdict=' ++ (vars.verdict as String)]

db:insert.doc:name: Save Transaction
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO transactions ( transaction_id, customer_id, instrument_last4, amount, currency, channel, merchant_id, merchant_country, mcc, device_id, ip_country_code, occurred_at, correlation_id, processing_status ) VALUES ( :transactionId, :customerId, :instrumentLast4, :amount, :currency, :channel, :merchantId, :merchantCountry, :mcc, :deviceId, :ipCountryCode, :occurredAt, :correlationId, :processingStatus ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE processing_status = VALUES(processing_status), correlation_id = VALUES(correlation_id)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ transactionId: vars.transaction.transactionId, customerId: vars.transaction.customerId, instrumentLast4: vars.transaction.instrumentLast4 default null, amount: vars.transaction.amount, currency: vars.transaction.currency, channel: vars.transaction.channel, merchantId: vars.transaction.merchantId default null, merchantCountry: vars.transaction.merchantCountry default null, mcc: vars.transaction.mcc default null, deviceId: vars.transaction.deviceId default null, ipCountryCode: vars.transaction.ipCountryCode default null, occurredAt: if (vars.transaction.occurredAt == null) null else ((vars.transaction.occurredAt as DateTime) as LocalDateTime), correlationId: vars.transaction.correlationId default null, processingStatus: vars.verdict }]

db:insert.doc:name: Save Fraud Score
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO fraud_scores ( transaction_id, fraud_score, verdict, model_version, reason ) VALUES ( :transactionId, :fraudScore, :verdict, :modelVersion, :reason ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fraud_score = VALUES(fraud_score), verdict = VALUES(verdict), model_version = VALUES(model_version), reason = VALUES(reason), scored_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ transactionId: vars.transaction.transactionId, fraudScore: vars.finalScore, verdict: vars.verdict, modelVersion: 'RULE_ENGINE_V1', reason: vars.reasonCode }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Fraud Rule Hit
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO fraud_rule_hits ( transaction_id, rule_code, rule_description, severity ) VALUES ( :transactionId, :ruleCode, :ruleDescription, :severity )

db:insert.doc:name: Update 10 Minute Velocity
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customer_velocity ( customer_id, window_minutes, window_start, transaction_count, total_amount ) VALUES ( :customerId, 10, DATE_SUB( NOW(), INTERVAL MOD(MINUTE(NOW()), 10) MINUTE ), :transactionCount, :totalAmount ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transaction_count = VALUES(transaction_count), total_amount = VALUES(total_amount)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ customerId: vars.transaction.customerId, transactionCount: ((vars.velocity10.transaction_count default 0) as Number) + 1, totalAmount: ((vars.velocity10.total_amount default 0) as Number) + (vars.transaction.amount as Number) }]

db:insert.doc:name: Update 24 Hour Velocity
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customer_velocity ( customer_id, window_minutes, window_start, transaction_count, total_amount ) VALUES ( :customerId, 1440, CURDATE(), :transactionCount, :totalAmount ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transaction_count = VALUES(transaction_count), total_amount = VALUES(total_amount)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ customerId: vars.transaction.customerId, transactionCount: ((vars.velocity24.transaction_count default 0) as Number) + 1, totalAmount: ((vars.velocity24.total_amount default 0) as Number) + (vars.transaction.amount as Number) }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build Fraud Alert
set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { eventType: 'FRAUD_ALERT', correlationId: vars.transaction.correlationId default null, transactionId: vars.transaction.transactionId, customerId: vars.transaction.customerId, verdict: vars.verdict, score: vars.finalScore, firedRules: vars.ruleHits, customerReasonCode: vars.reasonCode }]
